lens.name: Lens
lens.description: A transparent medium with two refracting surfaces.

refraction.name: Refraction
refraction.description: The bending of light as it passes through a lens.

centres_of_curvature.name: Centres of curvature
centres_of_curvature.description: The centers of the spheres that form the refracting surfaces of a lens.

optic_axis.name: Optic axis
optic_axis.description: An imaginary line passing through the centres of curvature and the optic centre.

aperture.name: Aperture
aperture.description: The area of the lens through which light passes.

principal_focus.name: Principal focus
principal_focus.description: A specific point where light rays converge or appear to diverge after passing through a lens.

white_light.name: White Light
white_light.description: Visible light composed of multiple spectral colors.

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: An optical device that transmits specific colors and blocks others.

primary_colours.name: Primary Colours
primary_colours.description: Fundamental colors that cannot be created by mixing others.

secondary_colours.name: Secondary Colours
secondary_colours.description: Colors formed by the combination of two primary colors.

opaque_objects.name: Opaque Objects
opaque_objects.description: Objects that reflect light rather than transmitting it.

light_reflection.name: Light Reflection
light_reflection.description: The process by which light bounces off an object to determine its perceived color.

transformer.name: Transformer
transformer.description: A deep learning architecture based on self-attention mechanisms.

multi_head_attention.name: Multi-Head Attention
multi_head_attention.description: A mechanism that allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces.

positional_encoding.name: Positional Encoding
positional_encoding.description: A technique to inject information about the relative or absolute position of tokens in a sequence.

softmax.name: Softmax
softmax.description: A function that turns a vector of K real values into a probability distribution.

layer_normalization.name: Layer Normalization
layer_normalization.description: A technique to normalize the inputs across the features for each training point.

feed_forward_network.name: Feed Forward Network
feed_forward_network.description: A standard neural network layer applied to each position separately and identically.
